title: vitamux connector-test scenario
description: Inputs for `vitamux connector-test --scenario`: which synthetic values sign in to the sidecar under test and which logins provoke which typed error. Synthetic values only, never real credentials. Without a scenario the kit checks the first auth step and fetches with placeholder credentials, which only a sidecar in REPLAY mode serves. login and credentials at the top level are the subject of the fetch checks.

stream.description: Stream to fetch; default: the first stream of describe.

rotated.description: A subject whose fetch hands back rotated credentials and whose refresh returns new tokens.

errors.description: A subject per typed error class: its fetch must end in that class.

subject.description: Who the kit acts as: the owner's answers to each auth step in turn (login), or ready-made credentials. Not both.

values.description: Answers to a prompt step, by field name.

callback.description: The OAuth callback query for a redirect step.
